entities.summary: Nikolaos "Nikos" Toskas is a retired Hellenic Army General and a politician currently serving as a Syriza member of the Hellenic Parliament for Athens B. He was Alternate Minister of Public Order and Citizen Protection since 23 September 2015 having previously been Deputy Minister of National Defense. He resigned from office on 3 August 2018.
